info.description: The Plaid REST API. Please see https://plaid.com/docs/api for more details.
info.title: The Plaid API

post.description: Send a new event to enrich user data and optionally get a Trust Index score for the event.
post.summary: Send a new event to enrich user data

event_id.description: The id of the recorded event.

TrustIndex.description: Represents a calculated Trust Index Score.

model.description: The versioned name of the Trust Index model used for scoring.

RequestID.description: A unique identifier for the request, which can be used for troubleshooting. This identifier, like all Plaid identifiers, is case sensitive.
RequestID.title: RequestID

FraudAttributes.description: Event fraud attributes as an arbitrary set of key-value pairs. The set of attributes returned varies by model.

device_session_id.description: Device Session ID should be provided for any event correlated with a frontend user session started via the Protect SDK.

request_trust_index.description: Whether this event should be scored with Trust Index. The default is false.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the event. Might be the current moment or a time in the past. In [ISO 8601](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format, e.g. `"2017-09-14T14:42:19.350Z"`

APISecret.description: Your Plaid API `secret`. The `secret` is required and may be provided either in the `PLAID-SECRET` header or as part of a request body.
APISecret.title: APISecret

device_session_id.description: If present, contains the current Device Session ID from the Protect SDK.

timestamp.description: The timestamp of the event, in [ISO 8601](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format, e.g. `"2017-09-14T14:42:19.350Z"`

ProtectUserSignUpEvent.description: This event type represents a user signing up for the application.

ProtectUserSignInEvent.description: This event type represents a user signing in to the application.

ProtectAppVisitEvent.description: This event type represents a user visiting the client application.

APIClientID.description: Your Plaid API `client_id`. The `client_id` is required and may be provided either in the `PLAID-CLIENT-ID` header or as part of a request body.
APIClientID.title: ClientID
